text:
PagerBot: PagerDuty: page fired -> Service: embeddings-prod-eu | Urgency: high (P1) | Symptoms: sustained 5xx for embedding requests, queue backlog rising, latency spike. PD incident: https://pd.example/incidents/INC-987654

Jordan: acked the PD, taking it now :hand:

IncidentBot: Auto-escalation: if no owner within 5m, escalate to oncall-sre. Owner: Jordan (ack). Notifying infra and platform channels.

Maya: high-level — customers impacted? any paying customers seeing errors or degraded responses?

Ben: quick triage: embedding workers in eu pool returning 503s and dropping connections. Backlog on redis queue up ~1200. Seeing repeated error in worker logs:
```
2026-03-14T10:02:11Z worker[embed-3]: ERROR kv_cache.rs: allocation failed: OOM when resizing KV cache
2026-03-14T10:02:12Z worker[embed-3]: WARN request_handler: upstream model returned 503
```

Ben: autoscaler didn't kick in — metrics-exporter on the dedicated nodes is OOM'ing and exiting, so HPA doesn't see load to scale. I can repro on one node with `kubectl -n embeddings logs metrics-exporter-embed-0`.

Jordan: initial mitigation: enabling cross-region fallback and routing new requests to eu-fallback (region) and increasing capacity on dedicated-pool-eu manually. Running:
```
infractl pools scale --pool dedicated-pool-eu-embed-1 --replicas 8 --reason "emergency - PD INC-987654"
```

Jordan: also applying quick routing override so embedding API routes non-critical customers to us-east while we stabilize. This will reduce pressure on eu pool.

Maya: noted — I'll coordinate with Support to message affected accounts. Ivy, can you start a bridge for customer comms and get the account team looped? Mark AcmeAnalytics as high risk (they reported errors).

Ivy-Support: on it. Creating support ticket and sending initial note to AcmeAnalytics CSM + account slack. ETA message queued.

Ben: root cause probe: metrics-exporter config drift — the daemonset selector expects label `node-role.kubernetes.io/embed` but nodes were labeled `node-role.kubernetes.io/embedding` after a config sync change last night. Exporter couldn't bind metrics to node and OOMed due to a mem leak in older image. Fix is to reconcile labels and roll exporter to patched image.

Ben: patch I applied (rolling update):
```
# fix node labels
kubectl label nodes eu-embed-node-{1..4} node-role.kubernetes.io/embed=true --overwrite

# upgrade exporter image
kubectl -n embeddings set image daemonset/metrics-exporter metrics-exporter=redwood/metrics-exporter:1.2.4-fix
```

Jordan: after scaling + label fix we see queue drain starting. Redis backlog dropping from 1200 -> 300 in ~6m. Error rate for embeddings in eu reduced from 18% -> 2%.

Samira: taking over incident for investigaton & postmortem (handing off from Jordan). I'll own next steps and RCA. Jordan — can you drop any runbook steps you've taken in the incident doc?

Jordan: pasted runbook snippet into INC-987654 doc. Key steps: 1) scale pool, 2) enable routing override, 3) reconcile labels, 4) roll metrics-exporter, 5) monitor queue and error rate.

Samira: confirmed mitigation stable. Customer impact: AcmeAnalytics had intermittent 503s for ~9 minutes, 4000 requests affected, degraded but no data loss. Support notified, we sent post-incident blurb and offered an incident review. No other enterprise customers flagged.

Maya: can we add short-term alert: exporter crash + node-label-mismatch? I'd like a meta-alert that triggers when exporter restarts >3 times in 5m or HPA sees stalled scaling.

Ben: will add alert. Also plan for longer-term: hardened canary for config-sync to avoid label drift, and patch to exporter image to reduce memory usage. I'll open two tickets assigned to eng-infra and eng-runtime.

Ivy-Support: AcmeAnalytics CSM confirmed they got the note and will escalate if they see recurrences. I logged the impact numbers in the support ticket.

Samira: follow-ups (summary):
- RCA owner: Samira
- Infra fix owner: Ben (metrics-exporter memory & config-sync guardrails)
- Alerts/tuning: Jordan & Ben
- Customer comms & postmortem: Ivy & Maya
- Postmortem doc: will be linked to INC-987654 and include timeline + action items.

PagerBot: PD incident INC-987654 marked resolved-ish by owner — will auto-close when incident doc has mitigation steps and customer contact logged.

Jordan: closing my active items; leaving monitoring for next 30m. Thanks all.

Samira: final note — creating postmortem draft and will schedule 30-min blameless review tomorrow. If anything spikes again ping me directly. :v:
